newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Honduras to be region's No.2 coffee producer.
newsitem.headline: Honduras to be region's No.2 coffee producer.

text.p: Honduras will become the region's number two producer behind Guatemala with the 1996-97 coffee harvest, according to the president of Honduras's Coffee Exporters Association (ADECAFE), Osmond Maduro.
"Some people do not believe the country is the second-biggest bean producer in Central America, but that is the reality," Maduro told reporters.
He estimated Honduras would harvest 3.5 millon bags of 100 pounds (46 kg) each, which would exceed the harvests of Costa Rica and El Salvador.
The expected harvest should be a record for Honduras, surpassed only by Guatemala's projected 3.7 million bags, he added.
